35.old: Under BC Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) regulations and City of Surrey A-1/A-2 zoning, the principal residence on an ALR parcel is capped at 500 m² (5,382 sq ft) of total floor area unless a non-adhering residential use application is approved by both the City of Surrey and the ALC.
35.new: ALC rules (BC Agricultural Land Commission) and the City of Surrey's A-1/A-2 zoning both limit the principal residence on an ALR parcel to a total floor area of 500 m² (5,382 sq ft). A non-adhering residential use application must be approved by the City of Surrey and the ALC before a larger home is allowed.
